decision: P2 starts with identity, as one connector class with two providers (Okta, Google Workspace)
why: the first-segment profile's order: half the segment has no Okta

decision: the connector id is the class (identity); records carry provider; weights and disputes name the class; citations keep the provider label
why: exposure is about identity, not a vendor; a company weights its identity source, whichever it uses
evidence: identity.test.ts: same exposure from both providers

decision: identity scenarios in a separate fixture (NORTHWIND_IDENTITY); the default demo keeps its moves and numbers
why: the Stage 1 demo and the recorded public demo must not move

decision: providers read only what their API returns; Google Workspace holds no app owners, so the decider stays missing
why: no vendor constraint is encoded beyond the API shape; missing evidence is not guessed

decision: review_overdue joins a group that administers an app with its last review date; computed only when a review date exists
why: no review date is missing evidence, never a supported gap
evidence: identity.test.ts: recent review no gap; no date unresolved

decision: leavers join HR terminations and active accounts in derive, after the viewer filter; a company grant (fixture grants) widens one record's audience
why: a derived fact inherits the narrowest audience of its contributors
evidence: identity.test.ts: without the HR grant the scenario is unresolved

decision: a stored engine holding okta state migrates on open: weight moved to identity with a logged weight_change (reason: connector class rename), old records and last read dropped, the class reads again; migrates once
why: the chain must say why decision IDs changed; no silent rekey
evidence: identity.test.ts: stored engine from before the class

decision: full suite, demo-check, parity, Stage 1 on a local Worker
why: the rename touches the hosted path
